turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: May I be so bold as to ask, Your Majesty, what specific assistance do you require from Mr. Holmes in this matter?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I have, I fear, placed myself in a precarious position, and I require your assistance in retrieving a compromising document that has been stolen from me.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: A compromising document, you say? I daresay, that is a euphemism for something far more significant. Tell me, Your Majesty, what exactly is at stake here?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I fear that if this document falls into the wrong hands, it may upset the delicate balance of power in Europe and have far-reaching consequences for my kingdom and, indeed, the entire continent.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must admit, Your Majesty, that I find this situation quite intriguing. May I inquire as to the nature of the document and the circumstances surrounding its theft?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must caution you, Your Majesty, that the nature of the document and the circumstances of its theft are crucial details. Please, tell me, who do you suspect of stealing it and why do you believe this document is so crucial to the balance of power in Europe?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I must confess, gentlemen, that I am at my wit's end. The document in question is a letter, written by my...ahem...former fiancée, to my brother, detailing a certain family secret that, if revealed, would be most...distasteful.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that this family secret of yours sounds rather more complicated than a simple matter of state security. May I assume that the lady in question is none other than Irene Adler, the opera singer, whom I have heard you are acquainted with?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: Tell me, Your Majesty, what is the nature of this family secret that you wish to keep hidden, and what is the significance of this letter to your brother?

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, if this letter has indeed fallen into the wrong hands, what measures have you taken to retrieve it and protect your family's reputation?

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I implore you, gentlemen, to understand the gravity of this situation. The revelation of this secret would not only compromise my family's honor, but also have far-reaching consequences for the balance of power in Europe.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must say, Your Majesty, that I am not convinced by your tale of a simple family secret. There are, I suspect, deeper currents at play here, currents that threaten to upset the entire diplomatic landscape of Europe.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must admit that I am intrigued by the complexity of this situation. I believe that, with your permission, Sherlock's extraordinary faculties of observation might be of great assistance in uncovering the truth.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: I am aware that my position is precarious, and I fear that my family's reputation is already beginning to unravel, but I assure you, gentlemen, that I am willing to do whatever it takes to prevent a catastrophe of this magnitude.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must see this letter, Your Majesty. I suspect that it holds more than just a family secret.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I must ask, what is the nature of this letter that you fear may be the source of this impending catastrophe?

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I must insist that you hand over the letter at once, Your Majesty. The sooner I examine it, the sooner we can begin to unravel the tangled threads of this affair.

turns.speaker: the King of Bohemia
turns.text: Gentlemen, I must confess that the thought of surrendering this letter, even to your extraordinary abilities, fills me with a sense of trepidation, for I fear the consequences of its contents being revealed.

turns.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
turns.text: I will not be deterred by your trepidation, Your Majesty. The letter is the key to this entire affair, and I will not be satisfied until I have examined it and unraveled its secrets.

turns.speaker: Dr. Watson
turns.text: Your Majesty, I assure you that we will handle the letter with the utmost discretion and respect for your confidentiality.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: I told you that I would call.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: Pray take a seat. This is my friend and colleague, Dr. Watson, who is occasionally good enough to help me in my cases. Whom have I the honour to address?

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You may address me as the Count Von Kramm, a Bohemian nobleman. I understand that this gentleman, your friend, is a man of honour and discretion, whom I may trust with a matter of the most extreme importance. If not, I should much prefer to communicate with you alone.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: It is both, or none. You may say before this gentleman anything which you may say to me.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Then I must begin, by binding you both to absolute secrecy for two years; at the end of that time the matter will be of no importance. At present it is not too much to say that it is of such weight it may have an influence upon European history.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You will excuse this mask. The august person who employs me wishes his agent to be unknown to you, and I may confess at once that the title by which I have just called myself is not exactly my own.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: The circumstances are of great delicacy, and every precaution has to be taken to quench what might grow to be an immense scandal and seriously compromise one of the reigning families of Europe. To speak plainly, the matter implicates the great House of Ormstein, hereditary kings of Bohemia.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: I was also aware of that

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: Our visitor glanced with some apparent surprise at the languid, lounging figure of the man who had been no doubt depicted to him as the most incisive reasoner and most energetic agent in Europe. Holmes slowly reopened his eyes and looked impatiently at his gigantic client.

opening.speaker: Sherlock Holmes
opening.text: If your Majesty would condescend to state your case, I should be better able to advise you.

opening.speaker: the King of Bohemia
opening.text: You are right. I am the King. Why should I attempt to conceal it?
